description: This file defines a service for aggregating hierarchical LLM (Large Language Model) costs, including functions for data projection, grouping, and index management, with a focus on normalizing schema variations and formatting output.

methods.name: projectionStage
methods.description: Creates a MongoDB aggregation projection stage to normalize and extract relevant fields from cost documents.

methods.name: addDateKeyStage
methods.description: Adds a date object to the aggregation pipeline, converting string dates to Date objects.

methods.name: projectDateKeyStage
methods.description: Projects fields including user, project, agent, tokens, cost, and formatted date string for grouping.

methods.name: groupByAgentDateStage
methods.description: Groups data by user, project, agent, and date, summing costs and tokens per day.

methods.name: groupAgentTotalsStage
methods.description: Aggregates agent data to compute total costs and organize costs and tokens by date.

methods.name: agentProjectStage
methods.description: Projects agent-level aggregated data with formatted costs and tokens.

methods.name: groupProjectStage
methods.description: Groups data at project level, summing costs and collecting agents.

methods.name: projectProjectStage
methods.description: Projects project-level data with total cost and list of agents.

methods.name: groupUserStage
methods.description: Groups data at user level, summing total costs and listing projects.

methods.name: finalProjectStage
methods.description: Projects final user-level data with total cost and list of projects.

methods.name: aggregateHierarchy
methods.description: Main function to perform hierarchical aggregation of LLM costs, returning structured user, project, and agent cost data.

methods.name: ensureLlmCostsIndexes
methods.description: Creates indexes on the 'llm-costs' collection to optimize query performance.
